start.text: You're the new tenant. Kenji. I keep to myself mostly. Don't mind me.

choices.text: You seem interesting. What do you do?

polite.text: Likewise. Most people here are... loud. It's nice to meet someone quiet.

choices.text: I like quiet too. Maybe we could talk sometime?

interest.text: I study... human psychology. Behavior. What drives people. Their desires, their fears. It's fascinating.

choices.text: That sounds intense. What kind of desires?

desires.text: The kind people hide. The kind that surface in the dark. This building... has a lot of darkness. And light, if you know where to look.

choices.text: I think I want to see that light.

therapist.text: Not exactly. I don't fix people. I help them understand themselves. Including their... kinks. Everyone has them.

trust.text: Even you. Especially you. You came to this building for a reason, even if you don't know it yet. I can help you discover it.

danger.text: Danger is just opportunity in disguise. But I won't force anything. The choice is always yours.

denial.text: Denial is the first stage. That's okay. We all start there. When you're ready to explore, come find me.

talk.text: I'd like that. I don't get many visitors. Come by my place anytime. I have tea. And... other things.

other.text: Rope. Candles. Restraints. Things that help people... let go. Of control. Of fear. Of shame.

help.text: I can teach you. Bondage, sensation, trust. But only if you truly want it. This isn't a game.

choices.text: I want to learn. Teach me.

lesson.text: Good. First lesson: trust. Close your eyes. Let me bind your wrists. And then... we'll see what your body tells you.
